situations.title: 사전연명의향·DNR 확인
situations.tagline: The chart says he has an advance directive — can you tell me exactly what he did and didn't want?
situations.brief: 문서와 의사에 따라 사전연명의향과 DNR 범위를 정확히 확인하고 가족과 함께 짚으세요.
keyPhrases: Your father completed an advance directive and a DNR order.
That means we won't do CPR, but we'll keep him comfortable.
Let's go through exactly what he asked for and didn't want.
goals: 사전연명의향과 DNR 범위를 문서에 근거해 확인한다
가족이 문서의 의미를 정확히 이해하도록 돕는다

situations.title: 목표설정 대화 준비 지원
situations.tagline: Before we all meet with the doctor, what should our family be thinking about?
situations.brief: 가족 회의를 앞두고 가족이 무엇을 결정해야 하는지 정리하도록 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: The team wants to meet so we can plan the next steps together.
It helps to think about what matters most to your mother.
You can write down any questions you want to ask the doctor.
goals: 가족이 회의에서 다룰 핵심 질문을 정리하도록 돕는다
환자의 가치와 바람을 미리 떠올리게 한다

situations.title: 임종기 증상 사정
situations.tagline: She keeps grimacing and her breathing sounds so labored — is she in pain?
situations.brief: 통증과 호흡곤란을 중심으로 임종기 증상을 사정하고 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching her face and breathing closely for any sign of discomfort.
That sound is common at this stage and we can ease it.
I'll give medication so she stays comfortable.
goals: 관찰 결과와 완화 계획을 가족에게 전달한다

situations.title: 편안함 중심 간호
situations.tagline: So we're not trying to cure her anymore — what will you actually be doing for her now?
situations.brief: comfort care로 전환된 환자의 돌봄 목표와 제공 내용을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Our whole focus now is her comfort and dignity.
We'll treat pain, keep her clean, and stop tests that don't help.
You can be with her as much as you'd like.
goals: comfort care의 목표와 제공 내용을 이해시킨다
가족이 곁에 머물 수 있음을 안내한다

situations.title: 가족 면회·임종 지지
situations.tagline: Is it okay if I just hold her hand and stay here with her?
situations.brief: 임종을 앞둔 환자 곁에 가족이 함께 머물도록 환경을 마련하고 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: Of course — please hold her hand and talk to her.
Hearing is often the last sense to go, so your voice matters.
I'll be right outside if you need anything at all.
goals: 가족이 편안히 곁에 머물 환경을 만든다

situations.title: 사후 처치·존엄 관리
situations.tagline: Can we have a little more time with him before you take him?
situations.brief: 사망 후 존엄을 지키는 사후 처치를 수행하고 가족의 작별을 배려하세요.
keyPhrases: Please take all the time you need to say goodbye.
I'll care for him gently and respectfully.
Let me know if there are any customs you'd like us to honor.

situations.title: 목표설정 회의 소통 지원
situations.tagline: The doctor used a lot of words — can you explain what all of that really means for my dad?
situations.brief: 목표설정 회의에서 가족이 정보를 이해하도록 소통을 촉진하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me put that in plainer terms for you.
The team is saying his organs aren't recovering as we'd hoped.
What questions can I help you ask the doctor right now?
goals: 복잡한 의료 정보를 이해 가능한 말로 풀어 전달한다
가족이 회의에서 궁금한 점을 표현하도록 돕는다

situations.title: 연명치료 중단 계획 실행
situations.tagline: We've decided to let him go — what happens step by step now?
situations.brief: 연명치료의 단계적 중단 계획을 가족에게 설명하고 실행 과정을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll withdraw the treatments gradually and keep him comfortable throughout.
First we'll stop the medications that aren't helping him.
At every step, comfort is our priority.

situations.title: 인공호흡기 철회 준비
situations.tagline: When you take the breathing tube out, will she suffer?
situations.brief: terminal weaning 절차와 예상 증상을 설명하고 철회를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Before we remove the tube, I'll give medication so she stays comfortable.
Her breathing may change and that's expected — we'll manage it.
You can stay right by her side the whole time.
goals: terminal weaning 절차와 예상 증상을 미리 설명한다
철회 전 완화 약물 준비를 확인한다

situations.title: 임종기 진정·진통 적정
situations.tagline: He still looks restless — can you give him something more?
situations.brief: 완화 진정 목표에 맞춰 진정과 진통을 적정하고 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll titrate his medication until he looks settled.
The goal is comfort, not to hasten anything.
Tell me if you notice any sign he's uncomfortable.
goals: 완화 진정과 진통을 증상에 맞춰 적정한다

situations.title: 죽음의 질 지표 관리
situations.tagline: How do you know she's really comfortable and not just quiet?
situations.brief: 증상 조절을 중심으로 죽음의 질 지표를 관리하고 가족에게 근거를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I check her face, breathing, and body for any sign of distress.
Her relaxed posture tells me the medication is working.
We keep adjusting so she stays peaceful.

situations.title: 완화의료팀 협진 연계
situations.tagline: We asked palliative care to come by — how can they help our family?
situations.brief: 완화의료팀 협진의 역할을 설명하고 가족과의 연계를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The palliative care team specializes in comfort and support.
They'll help with symptoms and with decisions ahead.
I'll coordinate so everyone is on the same page.

situations.title: 문화·종교 임종 요구 반영
situations.tagline: Our faith has specific rituals for this time — can the ICU allow them?
situations.brief: 임종 의례를 존중하며 문화적·종교적 요구를 돌봄에 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: Please tell me what rituals are important to your family.
We'll do our best to make space and time for them.
I'll let the team know so we can honor your wishes.
goals: 병동 환경 안에서 의례를 존중하도록 조율한다

situations.title: 가족 예기 애도 지원
situations.tagline: I keep crying even though he's still here — is something wrong with me?
situations.brief: anticipatory grief를 겪는 가족의 감정을 정상화하고 예기 애도를 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: What you're feeling is a normal part of loss.
Grieving before goodbye is very human.
There are counselors and chaplains here to support you.
goals: 예기 애도의 감정을 정상적인 반응으로 안심시킨다

situations.title: 장기기증 옵션 소통
situations.tagline: Someone mentioned donation — is that even something we can consider now?
situations.brief: 해당 시 장기기증 옵션을 존중과 신중함으로 제안하고 가족의 질문에 응하세요.
keyPhrases: Donation is an option some families find meaningful.
A specialized team can explain what it would involve.
There's no pressure — we'll follow whatever you decide.

situations.title: 인공호흡기 철회 중 증상 급변 관리
situations.tagline: Her breathing suddenly got worse — please, do something!
situations.brief: 인공호흡기 철회 중 급변한 호흡곤란을 신속히 완화하고 가족을 안정시키세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving her medication right now to ease her breathing.
This can happen and I'm managing it immediately.
Stay with her — I'm right here and she'll settle.
goals: 급변한 호흡곤란을 즉시 완화 약물로 조절한다

situations.title: 가족 내 목표 불일치 위기
situations.tagline: My brother wants to keep going but I know Mom wouldn't want this — help us.
situations.brief: 임종 목표를 두고 가족 간 갈등을 중재하고 윤리적으로 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: It's clear you both love her deeply.
Let's focus on what she would have wanted.
The ethics team can help us work through this together.
goals: 가족 간 목표 불일치를 중립적으로 중재한다

situations.title: 무의미한 치료 요구 갈등
situations.tagline: I don't care what the scans say — you have to do everything to save him!
situations.brief: futility 상황에서 무의미한 치료 요구에 공감하며 한계를 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear how much you want us to keep fighting for him.
The treatments that once helped are now causing harm.
We won't stop caring for him — our focus shifts to his comfort.

situations.title: 임종 급변·가족 위기 대응
situations.tagline: Is he dying right now? I can't — I can't do this!
situations.brief: 임종이 급박한 순간 급성 위기에 빠진 가족을 지지하고 곁을 지키세요.
keyPhrases: I'm right here with you and I won't leave.
His passing looks peaceful and he's not in pain.
Take a breath — you can talk to him, he can hear you.
goals: 급성 위기에 놓인 가족을 곁에서 안정시킨다

situations.title: 대리결정 부재·윤리위원회 연계
situations.tagline: He has no family we can find — who decides what happens to him?
situations.brief: 대리결정자가 없는 환자의 의사결정을 위해 윤리위원회 연계를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He has no identified surrogate, so we need the ethics committee.
Let's document everything we know about his prior wishes.
We'll follow the process to make decisions in his best interest.

situations.title: 젊은 환자 임종 특수 상황
situations.tagline: She's only twenty-eight — how do I tell her little kids their mom won't come home?
situations.brief: 젊은 환자의 임종이라는 특수 상황에서 가족의 정서와 윤리적 부담을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: There is no easy way, and you don't have to face it alone.
Child life specialists can help you talk with her children.
We'll support you and her family through every step.
goals: 젊은 환자 임종의 정서적 충격을 지지한다
자녀 지원 등 특수 자원을 연계한다
